25template <typename T>
26MOCHI_FORCE_INLINE constexpr T SignedSqrt(T a) {
27 auto sqrt = Sqrt(Abs(a));
28 return Select(a >= T{}, sqrt, -sqrt);
29}

31template <typename T>
32MOCHI_FORCE_INLINE constexpr T IntegralSqrt(T a) {
33 static_assert(
34 std::is_integral_v<T> && !std::is_same_v<std::remove_cv_t<T>, bool>, "Unsupported type");
35
36 // Base case.
37 if (a < 2)
38 MOCHI_UNLIKELY {
39 return a;
40 }
41
42 // Find square root using binary search.
43 T lo = T(1);
44 T hi = T(a / 2 + 1);
45 T ans = T(0);
46
47 while (lo <= hi) {
48 T md = (lo + hi + 1) / 2;
49
50 if (md <= a / md) {
51 if (md * md == a) {
52 return md;
53 }
54 lo = md + 1;
55 ans = md;
56 } else {
57 hi = md - 1;
58 }
59 }
60
61 return ans;
62}

67template <typename T>
68MOCHI_FORCE_INLINE constexpr T Sinc(T x) {
69 T x2 = x * x;
70 T x4 = x2 * x2;
71
72 if (x4 < std::numeric_limits<T>::epsilon())
73 MOCHI_UNLIKELY {
74 return T(1) - x2 / T(6);
75 }
76 else {
77 return Sin(x) / x;
78 }
79}
